post.description: Mints a single-use state bound to this chapter and returns the Discord authorize URL to send the admin to. No credential is returned and none is ever asked for: the only thing this flow stores per chapter is a guild id.

The OAuth callback does not link anything by itself: it parks what Discord told it and hands the browser a one-time token. This route is what binds the server, and it binds it only to the chapter this request is scoped to — so an authorization completed by somebody else, for a chapter they are not in, activates nothing.

info.description: The Operating System for Greek Life

permissions.description: Caller's effective permission set for the active chapter. Contains the wildcard `*` for Presidents. Empty array means no active roles.

filename.description: Original filename for the avatar image

distinct_id.description: Pseudonymous analytics id (HMAC of the user id), or null when analytics is unconfigured.

enabled.description: Whether analytics is enabled for this caller.

name.description: Behavioral event name in kebab-case, e.g. "opened-channel", "ran-slash-command". Must describe behavior, never content.

chapter_id.description: Chapter the event is attributed to (enables the opt-out gate)

properties.description: Behavioral, content-free properties. Values must be scalars (string/number/boolean/null); keys that look like content/PII (content, body, email, name, …) are rejected.

org_archetype.description: Org archetype key (ifc, npc, nphc, mgc, …). Defaults to ifc.

directory_id.description: chapter_directory row id when the chapter was matched

accept_terms_privacy.description: The admin accepted the Terms of Service and Privacy Policy. Must be true (spec/behavior/legal.md). The acceptance timestamp and policy version are recorded server-side from the session — never from this payload.

subscription_status.description: Read by the client subscription gate. Load-bearing — see `chapter-member-view.ts`.

past_due_since.description: Timestamp the chapter entered `past_due`, or null. Drives the 3-day client grace window; the grace predicate fails open without it.

analytics_opt_out.description: Per-chapter opt-out for the pseudonymous analytics pipeline. Mobile reads it off this payload.

logo_url.description: Signed URL for the chapter logo, or null when none is set or signing failed. Computed, not a column.

role.description: The Signet role that failed, e.g. `--signet-accent-text` or `--signet-accent-on-primary`.

against.description: What it was measured against — a hex background color, or another `--signet-*` role name.

ratio.description: Measured contrast ratio. Below 4.5 to appear here.

subscription_status.description: Read by the client subscription gate. Load-bearing — see `chapter-member-view.ts`.

past_due_since.description: Timestamp the chapter entered `past_due`, or null. Drives the 3-day client grace window; the grace predicate fails open without it.

analytics_opt_out.description: Per-chapter opt-out for the pseudonymous analytics pipeline. Mobile reads it off this payload.

failedContrastChecks.description: Signet §8 contrast checks below AA for this save’s generated accent. Empty in the normal case; the save still succeeds when non-empty — this is disclosure, never a rejection.

minutes_per_point.description: Minutes of approved service that earn one SERVICE point (default 60). Must be at least 1 — a rate of 0 would divide by zero when awarding.

key.description: Workflow key from the chapter catalog

analytics_opt_out.description: When true, disables pseudonymous product analytics for this chapter (data-retention.md #analytics-events-pseudonymous).

custom_fields.description: Custom-field values, present only on single-member reads and already filtered to the fields the requesting viewer may see.

user_id.description: users.id — the id chat carries as sender_id

display_name.description: May be an empty string: the column is NOT NULL DEFAULT '', so clients treat empty as unresolved rather than rendering a blank name.

custom_role_ids.description: Assigned chapter_custom_roles ids. Omit to leave custom-role assignment unchanged; an empty array clears it.

role.description: Role name to assign to invited member

emails.description: Email addresses to invite, one invite token per address

is_enabled.description: Whether notifications for this category are enabled

quiet_hours_start.description: Quiet hours start (HH:mm format, e.g. 22:00). Pass null or an empty string to clear.

quiet_hours_end.description: Quiet hours end (HH:mm format, e.g. 08:00). Pass null or an empty string to clear.

quiet_hours_tz.description: Time zone for quiet hours — must be a named zone this server can resolve (e.g. America/New_York). A fixed offset such as -05:00 is not portable and is rejected on the deployment runtime. Pass null or an empty string to clear.

unread_count.description: Messages in this channel newer than the caller’s read cursor, excluding their own and deleted ones. A channel never opened counts all of them.

mention_count.description: Subset of unread_count that mentions the caller. Mentions are resolved server-side at send time.

action_type.description: Action discriminator. `reaction:<emoji>` for emoji reactions, `vote` for poll votes (UPSERT), free-form for card actions.

level.description: all = every message; mentions = only when you are mentioned (default); off = muted, though @mentions still notify.

check_in_zone.description: Optional check-in geofence: polygon vertices a member must stand inside to check in. At least 3 points; the closing edge is implicit. Omit for an event with no geofence.

check_in_zone_name.description: Human-readable name for `check_in_zone`, shown on the mobile scanner ("Inside the Great Hall zone").

channel_id.description: When set with `client_message_id`, posts an interactive event card to this chat channel after the event is created (the `/event` slash command). Omit for dashboard creates.

client_message_id.description: Client-generated idempotency key for the chat card, reconciling the optimistic loading placeholder. Required alongside `channel_id`.

check_in_zone.description: Optional check-in geofence: polygon vertices a member must stand inside to check in. At least 3 points; the closing edge is implicit. Omit for an event with no geofence. Send an empty array to clear an existing zone.

check_in_zone_name.description: Human-readable name for `check_in_zone`, shown on the mobile scanner ("Inside the Great Hall zone").

scope.description: Which occurrences this applies to. `instance` (default) affects only this event. `series` affects the whole recurring series from now forward — occurrences that have already started are never modified or deleted, so attendance history is preserved.

token.description: Rotating token read from the host QR code (s22). Valid for its 30s window and the one immediately before it.

manualCode.description: Short rotating code typed off the host screen when the camera fails (e.g. "4KQ-88").

lat.description: Scanner latitude. Required when the event defines a check-in geofence; ignored when it doesn't.

lng.description: Scanner longitude. Required when the event defines a check-in geofence; ignored when it doesn't.

marked.description: Number of members newly recorded ABSENT. 0 when the event is not mandatory and targets no roles, or when everyone required already has an attendance record.

channel_id.description: When set with `client_message_id`, posts an append-only points card to this chat channel after the ledger write (the `/points` slash command). Omit for dashboard adjustments.

client_message_id.description: Client-generated idempotency key for the chat card, reconciling the optimistic loading placeholder. Required alongside `channel_id`.

success_url.description: URL to redirect on successful payment

cancel_url.description: URL to redirect on canceled payment

return_url.description: URL to redirect when leaving the portal

file_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the uploaded file

proof_path.description: Storage path to proof file (e.g. from upload)

review_comment.description: Optional comment for the member (especially on rejection)

channel_id.description: When set with `client_message_id`, posts an interactive task card to this chat channel after the task is created (the `/task` slash command). Omit for dashboard creates.

client_message_id.description: Client-generated idempotency key for the chat card, reconciling the optimistic loading placeholder. Required alongside `channel_id`.

pause_grace_minutes.description: Minutes a backgrounded session may stay paused before it auto-expires as PAUSED_EXPIRED.
Minutes a backgrounded session may stay paused before it auto-expires as PAUSED_EXPIRED.

accuracy_meters.description: GPS accuracy in meters for this fix, per the device location API. Optional so older clients that never send it keep working; omitting it skips the accuracy check entirely rather than rejecting the heartbeat.

content_type.description: MIME content type, as declared for the upload

effective_date.description: Date this document took effect (ISO date), distinct from the upload timestamp

sort_order.description: Display position. Defaults to the end of the list.

name.description: New folder name. Renaming re-files every document in the folder.

option_indexes.description: Option index(es) to vote for. Single choice: [0]. Multi choice: [0, 1].

promote_new_members.description: Also bulk-promote every New Member in the chapter to Member, in the same transaction as the archive. Members keep all their other roles. Defaults to false.

url.description: Signed download URL, valid for one hour

expires_at.description: ISO timestamp at which the URL stops working

row_count.description: Number of data rows in the document

truncated.description: True when the report hit the row ceiling, so the document is not a complete record of the chapter. row_count reports what was printed, not what matched.

row_limit.description: The row ceiling that "truncated" refers to

truncation_note.description: What was cut, when the row count alone does not say it — a roster whose point balances were summed from a truncated read is the right length, so row_limit on its own would describe a cut the document never took. Absent when the row count is the whole story.
truncation_note.example: point balances are incomplete — summed from the first 50,000 transactions

user_id.description: Filter by user ID (omit for chapter-wide)

window.description: Time window for totals (defaults to all-time). Defined identically to the points leaderboard: semester excludes the latest archive period; month is the trailing calendar month.

user_id.description: Filter by user ID (omit for chapter-wide)

consent_acknowledged.description: The admin confirms they have posted an in-channel notice in their Discord server telling members the history is being archived into Signet. Required — the API refuses without it, and the column is NOT NULL, so no import can exist that was not preceded by this.

guild_name.description: Discord server name, for display only.

source.description: `upload` (the default) imports a DiscordChatExporter export the admin uploads. `bot` reads the chapter's connected Discord server directly and requires a connection to exist first. Both run the same consent gate, the same channel mapping, and the same purge.

kind.description: `export` is a DiscordChatExporter JSON partition; `media` is a file from its `_Files` folder.

relative_path.description: The path as the export names it, relative to the export folder. This is the join key: the importer resolves an attachment by looking this string up, never by rebuilding a storage key.

part_index.description: Order of this JSON partition. Ignored for media.

upload_url.description: Short-lived signed URL; PUT the bytes to it.

content_type.description: The content type the API validated. Send exactly this on the PUT — the bucket allowlist judges what the uploader sends, and a browser reports an empty type for several formats a Discord archive carries.

mapping_action.description: What to do with this Discord channel. Always explicit — `chat_channels` has no unique constraint on (chapter_id, name), so a same-name match is never treated as an answer.

signet_role_key.description: Signet role key the admin intends for this Discord role. Informational only — nothing reads this to grant a permission, and the importer never assigns a role.

channels.description: Every channel and thread the bot can read, all recorded as `skip` until the admin says otherwise. Threads carry `parent_discord_channel_id` and are not mapped separately — they follow their parent.

warnings.description: What could not be enumerated, in the admin’s words — most often private archived threads, which Discord gates behind a Manage Threads permission this read-only bot deliberately does not request.

available.description: False when this environment has no Discord application configured. The DiscordChatExporter upload flow is unaffected either way — it is a separate path, not a fallback that switches on.

connected.description: Whether this chapter has a Discord server linked.

guild_id.description: The linked Discord server id. Always a string — a snowflake exceeds 2^53 and a JSON round trip through a number would name a different server.

connected_discord_username.description: The Discord account that authorized the install.

return_path.description: Dashboard path to return the browser to once Discord is done, e.g. `/discord-import`. Must be a site-relative path; anything else is replaced with the default. It is stored with the handshake rather than read off the callback, because the callback carries no session to re-authorise against.

authorize_url.description: Send the admin here. Includes the fixed permission bitfield (View Channels + Read Message History) and a single-use state.

expires_at.description: When the handshake stops being redeemable.

handshake.description: The one-time confirmation token the OAuth callback put on the redirect. It is delivered to exactly one place — the browser that completed the authorization — and activates only against a session whose active chapter matches the one that started the handshake.
